description: Discourage broad process killing: pkill/killall by name, and SIGKILL as a first resort.

no-pkill.message: Don't signal processes by name: pkill/killall patterns match more than you expect and can kill the user's editors, agents or servers. Find the process with `pgrep -fl <pattern>`, confirm it is the right one, then `kill <pid>`, or ask the user to run it.

kill-9.message: SIGKILL gives the process no chance to clean up (temp files, locks, child processes). Send SIGTERM first (`kill <pid>`) and escalate only if it does not exit.

incident.description: Actively firefighting; the user accepts broad process killing
